## Summary

**Ticket T-5005 — resolved.**

The Grafana dashboard gaps were caused by the Prometheus TSDB storage volume (`prometheus-k8s-db-prometheus-k8s-0`, 100Gi) running completely out of disk space at **03:02 UTC**. Pod logs showed repeated `no space left on device` errors when Prometheus tried to write to its WAL, causing every scrape to be silently dropped — explaining both the data gaps and the missed alerts.

**The fix** is a one-command, no-downtime PVC resize:
```bash
kubectl patch pvc prometheus-k8s-db-prometheus-k8s-0 -n monitoring \
  --type merge -p '{"spec":{"resources":{"requests":{"storage":"200Gi"}}}}'
```
This works because the `gp3-resizable` StorageClass has `allowVolumeExpansion: true` and uses the EBS CSI driver, and `ext4` supports online filesystem expansion while the Pod is running. The ticket note also recommends reducing the 30-day retention window and adding a disk-usage PrometheusRule to prevent recurrence.
